text: Recovering interrupted prior-run work: a crashed/interrupted run may leave an issue's WIP in a git STASH (not only in the working tree or a bare branch) — run 'git stash list' before assuming work was reverted/lost. Note 'git checkout stash@{N} -- <files>' STAGES those files, so a later gh-as-agent commit of other work sweeps them in; unstash into a scratch area or reset the index if you need separate commits.

To integration-test a commit-making CLI's git behaviour (knowledge/gh-as-agent) without an ambient identity, run the real CLI as a subprocess inside a temp `git init` repo with a stripped identity: HOME=empty tmp dir, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL/SYSTEM=os.devnull, and GIT_AUTHOR/COMMITTER_NAME/EMAIL popped from env.

buildAgentClaudeMd has TWO call sites whose output must stay byte-identical — saveAgentPrompt (seed) and the /internal/agents/:id/prompt-preview endpoint; any new per-agent opt (skills, skillDescriptions, knowledgeDigestRef) MUST be threaded through both or the preview diverges from what's seeded.

The skill.json startup backfill (and any bulk write to the GLOBAL skill pool) MUST live in admin-console, not the orchestrator: the orchestrator mounts /template-workspace (=/pool/skills) READ-ONLY, while admin-console mounts /pool RW. Both mount /workspace (team+agent skills) RW. So orchestrator can only stamp team-tier skills (_teamSkillDir) and agent dirs.

Skill move-transfer strand guard (skill-transfer #626): a move to GLOBAL never strands (universal fallback remains); a move to a TEAM tier can orphan grantees OUTSIDE that team -> POST /api/skills/transfer returns 409 with the agent-id list unless force:true (or a global copy of the name still exists). Move always archives the source to /workspace/skill-archive/<tierSeg>/<name>-<hash>-<ts>/ before deleting.

Skill deletion (skill-deletion.js #627): DELETE /api/skills/:name guards all tiers uniformly (409 lists blocking constructs), cascade:true deactivates blocking grants then deletes; the snapshot MUST be taken BEFORE cascade (an agent-tier cascade removes the very dir) and rolled back on a refused 409 delete so a blocked attempt leaves no orphan archive. Team Admin can delete a team skill without System Admin (permitDeletion team tier).

Skill archive layout (#627): every delete snapshots to /workspace/skill-archive/<tierSeg>/<name>-<hash>-<ts>/ + an archive-meta.json sidecar (same dir layout skill-transfer's MOVE writes — moved+deleted skills share ONE restore surface; deliberately a directory, NOT the ZIP the concept §3.3 wording implies). Restore via POST /api/skills/archive/restore excludes archive-meta.json from the restored dir; prune via planArchivePrune (pure, default 90d, System-Admin only).

skill-manifest.js forceHistory (added #628): an additive default-off stampManifest option that records a history entry + refreshes updatedAt/updatedBy WITHOUT bumping the version when contentHash is unchanged — used by the import round-trip so an export→import of byte-identical content continues the version chain and appends an 'imported' event (concept never-reset), instead of an endpoint-side history hack. Must be mirrored into BOTH byte-identical copies + a fixture stampCase.

Skill drift is computed on READ from three hashes (copy current, seed-time anchor in .aee/seeded-skills.json.contentHash, source current) via classifyCopyDrift in the byte-mirrored skill-manifest.js; a deleted source MUST be detected by absent SKILL.md, not by hashing the empty dir. Only 'outdated' is resyncable; resync reuses the additive _syncSkillIntoWorkspace path (no respawn) and is idempotent; diverged/conflict/orphaned/unknown are refused. Auto-resync gate skillResyncMode (default review) fans out only to 'auto' teams on a source edit (#629).

POST /api/skills/install (admin-console/api/api.js) delegates to the orchestrator /internal/agents/:id/skills/activate path — it writes the grant + syncs files with team-first resolution like a re-seed; it no longer does an ad-hoc cpSync file copy. The grant edit is the pure planAgentGrantEdit in orchestrator/skill-grants.js; a team-member's per-agent install writes skillsOverride materializing the inherited grant (fixes #630 AC1: install can no longer diverge from a full re-seed).

In this sandbox admin-console/ and orchestrator/ have no node_modules, so .jsx has no unit-test harness and auth.test.js fails on a missing express-rate-limit require (pre-existing/environmental, passes in CI). Validate JSX syntax with 'npx esbuild --loader=jsx' reading the file on stdin (exit 0 = clean parse); do NOT pass --bundle=false (invalid for transform).

Skill merge (#631, skill-merge.js): merge folds N skills into one target; provenance UNIONs sources' entryIds, extra-file collisions namespace under files/<source>/, grants naming a retired source migrate to the target (activate target FIRST then deactivate sources via orchestrator /internal/{teams,agents}/:id/skills/{activate,deactivate}), retired sources archived via the uniform archiveDeletedSkill path; retireSources defaults ON; target-tier permission (same permit helper as transfer/deletion). Pure planner + api.js IO caller, mirrors skill-transfer/skill-deletion.

admin-console/api tests: node_modules is often NOT installed in the agent environment, so 'node --test' fails auth.test.js with 'Cannot find module express-rate-limit' (api.js/auth.js require it). This is environmental, not a regression — verify feature work by running the pure test files directly (e.g. node --test skill-merge.test.js) + node --check api.js + esbuild parse of the .jsx, and note the unrelated auth failure in the PR.

Validating admin-console JSX with esbuild (no node_modules): 'npx esbuild --loader=jsx <path>' FAILS ('loader without extension only applies to stdin') when given a FILE PATH — use 'npx esbuild --loader:.jsx=jsx <path>' for paths, or pipe the file via stdin ('npx esbuild --loader=jsx < file').

Token telemetry (#655): usage records carry TWO repo identities — github.repo is owner/name (stamped by the poller) while git.repo is the short clone-dir basename; pr-events records must normalize to owner/name (repoFullName from PR/remote URL) so artifact-graph keys match tier-B nodes, and tier-C branch joins reconcile the short git.repo against the owner/name tail.

Skill-grant validation (skill-grant-validate.js #633): validateGrantNames(submitted, known, previous) rejects a name only if it is NEITHER a known skill NOR already in the prior grant — this resolves the AC2-vs-AC4 tension (block newly-typed unknowns, but preserve pre-existing dead grants so they're flagged in the UI, not dropped). Wired into PUT /api/agents/:id (skills for non-members, skillsOverride for members) + POST /api/teams(/stream) (create-mode uses previous=[] and global-only known set since the team pool doesn't exist yet). SkillPicker.jsx v2 takes skill OBJECTS (skills prop, not allSkills names) from GET /api/skills.
